title: You-yang Earthy Chinese Potatoes Yangzhou Fried Rice
description: A hearty and comforting one-pot dish featuring yukon gold potatoes, cure, and savory flavors of Yangzhou fried rice.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the yukon gold potatoes and stir-fry until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cure, soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), sugar, salt, and pepper, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the cooking wine and stir-fry until the liquid is almost completely evaporated, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the scallions and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Push the ingredients to one side of the wok or skillet, making a well in the center.
Add a little more oil to the well and pour in the beaten eggs.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through, breaking them up into small pieces as they cook.
Mix the eggs with the other ingredients.
Serve the You-yang Earthy Chinese Potatoes Yangzhou Fried Rice hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
